Warnings array is empty for well-formed HTML without problematic content

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Title</h1><p>Clean content with <a href='https://example.com'>a link</a>.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.warnings())
```
